issues.detail: The Greek 'εκ της του ουριου' (from the woman Uri) is translated as 'bởi vợ của U-ri' (by the wife of Uri). In Vietnamese, 'bởi' can imply agency (by means of/by), whereas the Greek indicates origin/source (from). More importantly, the Greek specifies 'the woman' (της του), which is omitted in the Vietnamese translation.
